The WikiPathways Methionine de novo and salvage pathway (WP:WP3580, FDR 1.2×10⁻¹³) also emerged from RaMP, reflecting the same metabolite cluster at pathway-granularity finer than KEGG maps. Supporting hits from cysteic acid (C00506, downstream of cysteine oxidation), adenosine (C00212, required for SAM synthesis), and choline (C00114, methyl-group donor upstream of homocysteine remethylation) further anchor the methyl-group metabolism narrative.
